name: 13: “dad, why do we have to move to Australia?”

lines.ref:
13: “dad, why do we have to
move to Australia?”

15: “dad, I miss our family
back home”

15: “dad, why are you working
when we're sleeping”

16: “dad, I don't know what to
do with my future”

“dad, you sacrificed so much…”

so I could have the
chance to dream.”

21: “dad, I got my first job
as a dentist”

24: “dad I got into
Orthodontics specialty training”

28: “dad, I won an award for my
research”

33: “dad, I'm helping people
like me love their smile”

“thank you mum and dad,
for sacrificing everything so I
could dream big”

audit.notes: This format relies entirely on authentic personal childhood and career progression photos spanning across 20 years, along with a vintage family photograph. A library of generic modern lifestyle b-roll cannot reproduce this timeline format.
audit.summary: A nostalgic photo slideshow tracking an immigrant daughter's journey from early childhood struggles to career success as an orthodontist, thanking her immigrant parents for their sacrifices.
